story.title: Humanitarian Evacuations Begin in Oleshky Amid Severe Shortages
story.summary: Evacuations of residents from Oleshky, a Russian-occupied town in southern Ukraine, commenced on October 30 as part of a joint relief operation involving both sides. This marks the first such operation in nearly five years of conflict. The area has faced dire food and medical shortages, prompting the urgent need for humanitarian assistance.

timeline_highlights.title: Escalating Attacks in Ukraine-Russia Conflict Result in Casualties
timeline_highlights.summary: Recent drone and missile attacks in the ongoing Ukraine-Russia conflict have resulted in multiple casualties. A Ukrainian drone strike in Russia's Voronezh region killed at least two people and injured 17, causing significant damage to buildings and a commuter train. In Ukraine, a Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv killed one person and injured 15, damaging university buildings and a major bridge. Additionally, Russian strikes in Odesa and Zaporizhzhia injured four people and sparked fires in the region.

timeline_highlights.title: Russian Strikes Cause Casualties and Fires in Kyiv and Kharkiv
timeline_highlights.summary: Recent Russian missile and drone strikes in Ukraine have resulted in casualties and significant damage. In Kyiv, one person was killed and 15 injured, with emergency workers rescuing a dog from the rubble of damaged university buildings and a major bridge. Meanwhile, a drone strike in Kharkiv injured five people, including a 4-year-old child, and ignited several fires, prompting firefighters to respond amid ongoing threats of further attacks.

timeline_highlights.title: Russian Drone Strike on Dnipro Train Station Kills at Least 14
timeline_highlights.summary: A Russian drone attack on a crowded train station in Dnipro, Ukraine, resulted in at least 14 fatalities and numerous injuries, including an 11-year-old boy. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky described the incident as a 'horrific' attack, emphasizing the need for a response from Ukraine's allies. The strike occurred despite a local cease-fire in other areas, highlighting the ongoing violence in the region.
key_facts: At least 14 people killed in a drone strike at a train station in Dnipro, Ukraine.
The attack injured several others, including an 11-year-old boy.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack 'horrific.'

event_overview.title: About Sudan Conflict
event_overview.subject: Sudan Conflict
event_overview.summary: The Sudan conflict is an ongoing armed struggle that began on 15 April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), led by Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), led by Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo. What began with fighting in and around Khartoum rapidly spread across Sudan, including Darfur and Kordofan, causing a nationwide humanitarian and displacement crisis and extensive damage to civilian infrastructure.

facts.label: Start date and principal parties
facts.value: Armed hostilities began on 15 April 2023 between the SAF and the RSF; the conflict followed a power struggle and disagreements linked to security-sector reform and the proposed integration of the RSF into the regular armed forces.

facts.label: Geographic scope
facts.value: The conflict began in Khartoum and Merowe and quickly engulfed Darfur; it has since affected much of Sudan, with Khartoum, Darfur and Kordofan among the principal conflict-affected regions.

facts.label: Political context
facts.value: The war interrupted efforts to restore a civilian-led transition after Sudan's October 2021 military coup, following the 2019 overthrow of former president Omar al-Bashir.

facts.label: Humanitarian impact
facts.value: UN agencies describe the conflict as driving mass internal and cross-border displacement, acute hunger, and severely constrained access to essential services such as water, health care and shelter.

facts.label: Conduct of hostilities and civilian prot
facts.value: UN human-rights reporting has documented allegations of indiscriminate attacks in populated areas, including attacks involving airstrikes, shelling and explosive weapons, as well as other serious violations affecting civilians.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline follows chosen developments, including reported effects on electricity infrastructure, rather than providing a complete record of Sudan's war, humanitarian response, territorial changes, or all alleged violations.

related_stories.title: Court Ruling Allows Russia to Compete in Ice Hockey World Championships
related_stories.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport has ruled that Russian teams must be permitted to participate in international ice hockey tournaments, overturning the IIHF's previous ban imposed due to Russia's invasion of Ukraine. This decision reinstates Russia's eligibility for the 2026-27 season championships.

related_stories.title: Novaya Gazeta, Last Independent Newspaper in Russia, Announces Closure Amid Kremlin Pressure
related_stories.summary: Novaya Gazeta, one of the last independent newspapers in Russia, has announced its closure due to increasing pressure from the Kremlin. The newspaper has been a vocal critic of the Russian government's actions, particularly regarding the war in Ukraine. This closure marks a significant step in the ongoing crackdown on dissenting voices in Russia.

related_stories.summary: The zoo near Islamabad has introduced a new attraction called 'Coffee with Alpaca,' allowing visitors to enjoy drinks and snacks while interacting with ten imported alpacas. This initiative marks the first time alpacas have been featured in a zoo in Pakistan.

related_stories.title: Netanyahu Accused of Smearing Arab Parties After Election Loss
related_stories.summary: Following the recent elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been accused of using smear tactics against Arab Israeli parties, alleging they received foreign support to 'steal' the election. His coalition lost its parliamentary majority, prompting calls for investigations into alleged vote buying. As opposition parties begin coalition negotiations, Netanyahu's claims have sparked accusations of attempting to delegitimize the election results.
